_description: T19 (mechanism, distance-only): configs/mi200.json unchanged plus cuckoo-filter-less nearby WG stealing between the GPMs of unified kernels. Every key below is a T19 flag (default off / default value in the simulator); no mi200 or hpca parameter is changed. The parameter values repeat the simulator defaults so that the run is self-describing.
_t19-steal: Turn on WG stealing: each GPM keeps MGPUSim's static contiguous range, but WGs not yet dispatched can be taken from the tail by other GPMs; GPMs with an empty range also get the launch. Steal requests and replies are real messages between the command processors over the wafer mesh.
_t19-radius: GPMs advertise their queued-WG count to GPMs within this many hops (near victims).
_t19-fallback: Steal from farther GPMs (nearest first) when no near GPM has enough work.
_t19-min-victim-wgs: 0 = 2 x chunk: a victim keeps at least one chunk.
_t19-adv-period-ns: Near advertisement period; far GPMs are advertised every t19-far-adv-period-ns. A thief sees the count at the last period boundary at least t19-adv-fixed-ns + hops x t19-adv-hop-ns old (36 ns per hop = half of the 71.4 ns/hop RDMA round-trip slope measured in T14).
_t19-victim-cycles: CP cycles the victim needs to serve a steal request.
_t19-initial-split: static = MGPUSim's split (as mi200). balanced is an option for a separate, user-approved experiment only.
